about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I worked as a gas engineer for about five years, then graduated from the Computer Programming diploma program at Conestoga College in June 2026.
I'm especially interested in technical sales — roles where I can combine hands-on engineering experience with software skills to understand technical problems and explain solutions clearly.
Through my coursework and personal projects, I've worked with clean architecture patterns, REST APIs, and modern TypeScript ecosystems. I care about code quality and developer experience.
I also enjoy building full-stack web applications and writing clean, testable code. When I'm not coding, I like learning new tools, documenting what I learn, and contributing to open-source projects.

forum.title: Forum Web App
forum.description: A full-stack Reddit-style forum application with a clean architecture backend (Node.js/TypeScript) and a JavaScript frontend. Features user authentication with JWT, post and comment creation, a like system, and an admin dashboard. The backend is organized into domain, application, and infrastructure layers for maintainability and testability, with Jest unit tests covering core use cases.

sorting.title: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
sorting.description: An interactive real-time visualizer for three classic sorting algorithms — Bubble Sort, Merge Sort, and Quick Sort — built with Python and Pygame. Color-coded elements highlight comparisons (orange) and sorted items (purple), while live counters track comparisons and swaps. Users can reset the array, adjust animation speed with arrow keys, and switch algorithms on the fly.

booking.title: Meeting Room Booking App
booking.description: A cross-platform mobile application for booking meeting rooms, built with Flutter and Dart. Designed to run on Android and iOS, the app provides a streamlined interface for viewing room availability and making reservations. The project demonstrates multi-platform development with a single shared codebase targeting mobile, web, and desktop environments.
